inputs.label: Spectral ratios
inputs.coverage: DLR’s published Clementine-style composite of photometrically corrected Dawn images: red is 749/438 nm, green is 749/917 nm, and blue is 438/749 nm. Colors emphasize spectral differences; they are not natural color or a mineral-abundance measurement. Original seams and color fringes remain. Exact black is treated as likely fill, so some dark observations may also be withheld; gaps use the gray grid.
